pilotScope.nonBaselineMethodGate: Use transitmethod-101 only after the method-update gate, plan, approvals, benchmark evidence, and rollback record are ready.

statusCommands.answers: Next forecast run, create time, close time, and dry-run schedule action.
Next campaign run waiting for or due for resolution.
Due resolver jobs and the exact checked resolve command to inspect before execution.
Whether a run can append comparable evidence or only an exclusion audit row.

statusCommands.command: python3 scripts/ope.py prediction-campaign append --ledger-case comparable_scored --view summary
statusCommands.answers: Comparable and excluded row counts for the checked append row shape.
Current exclusion rate and maximum exclusion rate allowed before calibration claims.

statusCommands.command: python3 scripts/ope.py prediction-campaign calibration-status --campaign predictioncampaign-001 --from-local-ledger --view pilot
statusCommands.answers: Comparable resolved count against the 100-outcome calibration threshold when local ledger review is explicit.

runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Confirm geography, service window, 100-run target, source policy, and baseline method boundary.
runbookSteps.successSignal: Runbook scope reports targetRunCount=100 and bestAvailableMethodId=transitmethod-100.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: Stop and review source policy or domain setup before any campaign write.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: Scope review is not forecast evidence.

runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Confirm exactly three planned runs and no duplicate keys.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: Fix planning input before the real 100-run campaign.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: Mini smoke records are operational checks, not calibration evidence.

runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Confirm the foreground tick reports dry_run_ready and zero forecast artifacts created.
runbookSteps.successSignal: JSONL tick returns without writing state.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: Do not start the real pilot until the mini tick passes.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: Dry-run smoke output must not be counted as pilot evidence.

runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Confirm 100 unique planned runs, first/final service dates, and duplicate audit status.
runbookSteps.successSignal: materializationMode is full_100_run_pilot and duplicateConflictCount is zero.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: Do not write local state; repair plan inputs first.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: A full plan is not evidence until forecasts are created before close and later resolved.

runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Confirm historical-only pre-calibration is ready, scoped before the first pilot service date, and bound to transitmethod-100.
runbookSteps.successSignal: preCalibrationStatus is ready and calibratedProbability is visible before any forecast write.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: If pre-calibration is blocked, either fix the historical source or launch without --pre-calibrate.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: Pre-calibration sets only a prospective baseline probability and does not create a quality claim.

runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Run only inside the forecast creation window and keep stdout/logs; the launch clock is real UTC now, so --now is never needed for a live launch.
runbookSteps.successSignal: One ready forecast is created idempotently in .ope/live for the next due run, with forecastedAt stamped at the actual launch time.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: If close time has passed, the launch records the run as missed automatically and creates nothing; never backfill.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: Forecast creation still uses the baseline method, with optional historical pre-calibration, until method-update gates permit otherwise.

runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Read next forecast, next resolution, due resolver jobs, append readiness, ledger counts, exclusion rate, and calibration progress.
runbookSteps.successSignal: Operator status remains internally consistent and below-threshold claims stay blocked.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: Use doctor/resume when queues disagree or an interrupted state is reported.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: Status readbacks do not mutate campaign state or imply model quality.

runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Attach only outcome evidence that is eligible after the horizon ends.
runbookSteps.successSignal: Resolution and scoring artifacts are written for the due run.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: If outcome evidence is missing, write an explicit missing-outcome exclusion instead of inventing data.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: Outcome rows must be resolution-only and must not change the original forecast.

runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Confirm comparable append checks and provenance are complete.
runbookSteps.successSignal: Append-only ledger has one more comparable or exclusion row with a stable row key.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: If checks fail, append an exclusion audit row or leave the run out of comparable evidence.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: Ledger append grows evidence but does not itself allow a calibration claim.

runbookSteps.command: python3 scripts/ope.py prediction-campaign calibration-status --campaign predictioncampaign-001 --from-local-ledger --view pilot
runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Confirm comparable count, exclusion rate, provenance completeness, reliability buckets, and confidence caveats.
runbookSteps.successSignal: At 100 comparable outcomes with acceptable exclusions and provenance, measurement-only calibration is ready.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: Continue collecting or review exclusions until the threshold is met without unsafe evidence.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: Calibration readback is measurement-only and does not update probabilities.

runbookSteps.command: python3 scripts/ope.py prediction-campaign method-update-plan --method-update-plan-case plan_ready --view command
runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Only after calibration, benchmark, anti-leakage, source-policy, approval, and rollback checks pass.
runbookSteps.successSignal: Plan-ready command targets transitmethod-101 prospectively and keeps rollback available.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: If evidence is weak or approvals are missing, continue on transitmethod-100.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: The best available method is baseline until an explicit local apply command is approved.

runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Inspect interrupted state, idempotency keys, queue state, and next safe action.
runbookSteps.successSignal: Resume readback points to one safe next command without overwriting prior evidence.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: Escalate manually if duplicate keys, unsafe paths, or malformed local state are present.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: Recovery must preserve prior forecasts and append-only evidence.

runbookSteps.operatorCheck: Apply abort criteria for source outages, unsafe evidence, clock drift, path failures, and repeated missed windows.
runbookSteps.successSignal: Stop condition is documented before any restart.
runbookSteps.recoveryAction: Restart only from a clean mini smoke and explicit resume/readback sequence.
runbookSteps.claimBoundary: An aborted pilot cannot support quality or calibration claims.

commands.answers: Three planned Helsinki morning-peak runs with unique duplicate keys.
Three schedule rows covering ready, waiting, and missed-run policies.
One bounded foreground tick that does not write state without --write-local.
Campaign-aware resolver queue readback before any resolver execution.
Append-readiness gate for the first checked campaign run.

checks.expected: Mini plan contains exactly predictionrun-1301 through predictionrun-1303.
Ready forecast action is only available before forecastCloseAt.
Mini smoke commands do not write ignored campaign state unless --write-local is explicit.
Resolver jobs are visible before outcome execution and remain non-executing.
Append readiness is visible and cannot count evidence without resolution and scoring records.

miniCampaignSmoke.passCondition: All five mini-smoke commands return valid JSON or JSONL and no command writes campaign state without --write-local.

successCriteria.requirement: The pilot has at least 100 comparable resolved and scored outcomes.
successCriteria.measurementCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py prediction-campaign calibration-status --campaign predictioncampaign-001 --from-local-ledger --view pilot

successCriteria.requirement: The exclusion rate is at or below the declared 0.25 maximum.
successCriteria.measurementCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py prediction-campaign calibration-status --campaign predictioncampaign-001 --from-local-ledger --view readback

successCriteria.requirement: Every counted forecast was created before forecastCloseAt.
successCriteria.passCondition: No missed-close or backfilled forecast is counted as comparable evidence.

successCriteria.requirement: No campaign date/window duplicate key produced a second forecast.
Every comparable row has forecast, evidence, history, resolution, scoring, and source-policy paths.
successCriteria.measurementCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py prediction-campaign calibration-status --campaign predictioncampaign-001 --from-local-ledger --view readback

successCriteria.requirement: The pilot uses transitmethod-100 until a method-update plan is explicitly approved and applied.
successCriteria.passCondition: methodUpdateAllowed remains false unless plan-ready evidence and approvals exist.

abortCriteria.trigger: Required weather or transit outcome sources are unavailable for repeated due windows.
abortCriteria.requiredAction: Pause new writes, append explicit exclusions where appropriate, and resume only after source readiness is restored.

abortCriteria.trigger: A source policy would allow post-close evidence, private rows, credentials, or unapproved inputs.
abortCriteria.requiredAction: Stop the pilot and replace the source policy before any further forecast or resolution work.

abortCriteria.trigger: Runner clock drift causes repeated missed forecast windows or forecast-after-close risk.
abortCriteria.requiredAction: Stop foreground execution and restart only after time synchronization and a clean mini smoke.

abortCriteria.trigger: Any local write target escapes the ignored .ope/live prediction-campaign workspace.
abortCriteria.requiredAction: Stop immediately; do not write or append until path safety is repaired.

abortCriteria.trigger: Duplicate keys, duplicate row keys, or overwrite attempts appear in campaign state.
abortCriteria.requiredAction: Preserve existing records, block the duplicate, and resume only from the next unique window.

abortCriteria.trigger: Repeated missed forecast-close windows prevent a meaningful 100-comparable-outcome pilot.
abortCriteria.requiredAction: Stop the current cycle, summarize exclusions, and restart a fresh cycle after fixing scheduling.

warnings: This runbook is a checked local operations readback; it does not start the real pilot by itself.
The three-run smoke path must pass before the 100-run pilot is started with explicit local writes.
Optional pre-calibration must use historical-only data and stays on the baseline method.
The best available method remains transitmethod-100 until evidence and approvals explicitly permit a prospective method update.
Calibration after 100 comparable outcomes is measurement-only and does not rewrite historical forecasts or probabilities.
